description: The file 'error_handling.cpp' implements error handling, warning, and firmware error management functionalities for a firmware project. It includes initialization of error streams, functions to handle warnings and errors, and integrates with hardware components like LCD and engine state.

classes.name: LoggingWithStorage
classes.description: A helper class for logging that manages storage buffers.

methods.name: getFirmwareError
methods.description: Returns the current firmware error message buffer as a const char pointer.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Handles issuing a warning with a specific code and formatted message, managing warning stream updates.

methods.name: firmwareError
methods.description: Handles critical firmware errors by setting flags, logging the error message, and possibly halting the system.
